entities.summary: Tenri University  is a Japanese private university in Tenri, Nara Prefecture, an independent part of the secular mission of the new religious movement Tenrikyo. It was established in February 1925 as the coeducational Tenri Foreign Language School , enrolling 104 students, and was reorganised as a university in April 1949.
